title: An Evening We Won’t Forget — Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter with Xavier. 15 out of 10!
text:
Kary and I had an absolutely wonderful evening exploring Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter with Xavier on Sunday, August 23, 2026, and if I could give this tour 15 out of 10, I would!

Our tour began at the NH Podium in Barcelona at 6:00 PM, and Xavier was right on time. From the very beginning, he made us feel comfortable and welcome. There was never any awkward searching for something to talk about—the conversation just flowed naturally throughout the entire evening.

title: Perfect evening in Barcelona!
text: We enjoyed this tour so much.  We did this private tour with another couple so we had two guides. It was amazing!  Aleix and Alisenda were so kind, knowledgeable and easy to talk with.  They gave us great information about Barcelona and we had delicious food and drinks as well.  Perfect evening!!

title: Wonderful experience!

title: A great evening of a food and Barcelona tour
text:
This tour with Nuria was amazing! This was our last stop on our Spain adventure 
and we were getting tired we almost didn’t go, but we were so glad we did! We were thinking what  else could we do and taste but Nuria was amazing. We have the best time she did a tour of a different cathedral 
On our way to our first food stop that we didn’t goto before  she gave his historical facts , tips and even where we should eat the next day since we didn’t have paella yet. I couldn’t recommend this tour enough!
